say:2:1360236001:1.text: Ah, this isn't fun anymore. Let's call it a day.

say:3:1360236002:1.male: By the way, seeing my friends getting punished here really got me thinking...
say:3:1360236002:1.female: By the way, seeing my friends getting punished here really got me thinking...

say:4:1360236003:1.text: It seems that you've achieved a lot in a short time, Merlin.
say:4:1360236003:1.source_cn: 感觉梅林你在这短暂的恢复记忆期间，还真是战果累累啊。

say:7:1360236006:1.text: Alright, it's time to say goodbye. See you again soon!

say:7:1360236006:1.female: Alright, it's time to say goodbye. See you again soon!

say:8:1360236007:1.text: I hope you'll be in one piece when the time comes, not the half-dead, burned, and amnesiac version I saw last time.

say:10:1360236008:1.text: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!
say:10:1360236008:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈哈，我就接受你的祝福吧！梅林！
say:10:1360236008:1.male: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!
say:10:1360236008:1.female: Hahaha, I'll gladly accept your blessing!

say:11:1360236009:1.text: Not only will I make sure I'm in good shape, but I'll also prepare a huge surprise for you!
say:11:1360236009:1.source_cn: 我会争取下次见面时变得半死不活伤痕累累，然后——给你个...
say:11:1360236009:1.male: Not only will I make sure I'm in good shape, but I'll also prepare a huge surprise for you!
say:11:1360236009:1.female: Not only will I make sure I'm in good shape, but I'll also prepare a huge surprise for you!

say:12:1360236012:1.source_cn: 别了、再见、再会——啊哈哈哈哈！

say:14:1360236013:1.text: Following a burst of psychotic laughter, Berial vanishes.
say:14:1360236013:1.source_cn: 在癫狂的笑声中，贝利尔的身影消失了。

say:16:1360236014:1.text: The next moment, Tasi appears at the cave entrance.
say:16:1360236014:1.source_cn: 而下一刻，塔西的身影出现在了洞口。

say:17:1360236015:1.text: Guys! I knew you would be here!
say:17:1360236015:1.source_cn: 梅林！还有满满和漫漫，果然，我就知道你们在这里！

say:19:1360236016:1.text: Tasi! You... You're the real deal, right?

say:20:1360236017:1.text: Huh? Did you just run into a doppelganger of mine? Don't worry, I'm the real Tasi.
say:20:1360236017:1.source_cn: 嗯？别害怕，你们是遇到了虚假的我吗？放心吧，我是真的。

say:21:1360236018:1.text: But... why do you seem like you already knew Magister would be here?
say:21:1360236018:1.source_cn: 但，但你为什么一副早就知道主人在这里的样子啊？

say:22:1360236019:1.text: Have you met our doppelgangers too?
say:22:1360236019:1.source_cn: 难道，你也遇到了假的主人和我们吗？

say:23:1360236020:1.text: I didn't. You two have nothing to worry about! With Merlin by your side, no evil can touch you.
say:23:1360236020:1.source_cn: 也没有，你们放心吧，有着梅林在身边，任何邪恶都无法侵害你们。

say:24:1360236021:1.text: Actually, I already put two and two together when you first arrived, but I was too busy to check out the cave at that time.
say:24:1360236021:1.source_cn: 其实呀，你们刚刚过来的时候，我就已经知道了，只是那时无...

say:25:1360236022:1.text: Recently, the island has been crawling with evil Hypofiends and shadow monsters.
say:25:1360236022:1.source_cn: 因为不久前，整个岛到处都出现了邪恶的魔物与影子扭曲而成...

say:26:1360236023:0.text: Ulmus and I were trying to ease the situation just now. As things got intense, a soothing tune of flute drifted in from nowhere...
say:26:1360236023:0.source_cn: 我与奥曼斯爷爷分头去安抚，正在紧张的时候，突然传来了一...

say:27:1360236024:1.text: The next moment, all the Hypofiends and monsters melted away like ice under the blazing sun.
say:27:1360236024:1.source_cn: 然后，所有的魔物和怪物就像冰雪遇到艳阳一般，融化消失了。

say:28:1360236025:0.text: No wonder Magister saw through him but still played along! Clever!
say:28:1360236025:0.source_cn: 原来如此，怪不得主人明明识破了贝利尔，还要顺着他的意思...

say:29:1360236026:0.text: Magister focused the flute's power on cleansing the island instead!
say:29:1360236026:0.source_cn: 因为主人是借机将笛声释放出去，顺应净化了整个岛的影响！
say:29:1360236026:0.male: Magister focused the flute's power on cleansing the island instead!
say:29:1360236026:0.female: Magister focused the flute's power on cleansing the island instead!

say:30:1360236027:0.text: Why didn't Magister just cleanse Berial right there and then...?
say:30:1360236027:0.source_cn: 不过，主人干嘛不当时直接顺手净化掉近在眼前的贝利尔呢……
say:30:1360236027:0.male: Why didn't Magister just cleanse Berial right there and then...?
say:30:1360236027:0.female: Why didn't Magister just cleanse Berial right there and then...?

choice_prompt:31:1360236101.text: Plus, constantly twisting sounds would be far too draining for his weak shadow.
choice_prompt:31:1360236101.source_cn: 在这种场合下，用腐坏的魔力扭曲不知何时会发生的声音，对实力不足的影子来说消耗更会暴涨。

say:32:1360236102:1.text: I see! Magister just acted clueless to get Berial to talk more!
say:32:1360236102:1.source_cn: 明白了，主人也想装作不知，借机从贝利尔那里套更多话出来！
say:32:1360236102:1.male: I see! Magister just acted clueless to get Berial to talk more!
say:32:1360236102:1.female: I see! Magister just acted clueless to get Berial to talk more!

say:33:1360236104:1.text: It's impressive how composed you were when facing a Hypogean, Merlin!
say:33:1360236104:1.source_cn: 在恶魔面前还这么游刃有余，不愧是梅林！
say:33:1360236104:1.male: It's impressive how composed you were when facing a Hypogean, Merlin!
say:33:1360236104:1.female: It's impressive how composed you were when facing a Hypogean, Merlin!

say:34:1360236105:0.text: However, seeing how he timed everything so perfectly, maybe it was all part of his plan... We can't let our guard down just yet.
say:34:1360236105:0.source_cn: 不过，看那个恶魔时机把控得那样精准，或许这些也在他的计...
say:34:1360236105:0.male: However, seeing how he timed everything so perfectly, maybe it was all part of his plan... We can't let our guard down just yet.
say:34:1360236105:0.female: However, seeing how he timed everything so perfectly, maybe it was all part of his plan... We can't let our guard down just yet.

say:35:1360236028:1.text: Now that the crisis is over, you recount the situation to Tasi.
say:35:1360236028:1.source_cn: 解除警戒后，你们与塔西交流了来龙去脉。

say:36:1360236029:1.text: With danger still lurking on the island, Ulmus and Tasi can't handle everything by themselves.
say:36:1360236029:1.source_cn: 由于岛上还仍然可能潜藏着危机，而只靠她与奥曼斯处理，只...

say:37:1360236030:1.text: So, you settle on a solution...

say:38:1360236031:0.text: Oh, you mean this holds Dunlingr's power? Great! It's exactly what we need right now.
say:38:1360236031:0.source_cn: 哎呀，那位顿里尔大人的力量吗，太棒了，这正是现在我们最...

say:39:1360236032:1.text: I must say the clock looks kinda cute.
say:39:1360236032:1.source_cn: 没想到那样威严的大钟变成实体，居然也有些可爱。

say:40:1360236033:1.text: Hmm, is this a wake-up call or a lullaby?
say:40:1360236033:1.source_cn: 呵呵，这究竟是起床的铃声还是入睡的安眠曲呢？

say:41:1360236034:1.text: Anyway, with Dunlingr's power in play, I'm sure the island will be peaceful again soon.
say:41:1360236034:1.source_cn: 不过，有顿里尔大人帮忙，一定岛屿会很快重归宁静的美梦吧。

choice:31:0:1.female: I didn't want to alarm him.

say:43:1360236103:1.female: Haha, no way! Hm... I see! Magister just acted clueless to get Berial to talk more!

choice:9:1:2.text: Talk to me with your true self.
choice:9:1:2.male: Talk to me with your true self.
choice:9:1:2.female: Talk to me with your true self.

say:46:1360236005:1.source_cn: 我确实是在发自内心地夸奖你哦，梅林，因为你带来了这么多乐趣！
